title: Get 1TB of Koofr storage for just $159.99 without any monthly fees
excerpt: Access via smartphone, computer, or WebDAV.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get 1TB of Koofr cloud storage for one $159.99 payment (reg. $810) for a limited time, with code KOOFR.

Credit: Koofr

$159.99
$810 Save $650.01

While cloud storage is now a necessity, keeping track of another recurring payment is most certainly not. Koofr’s 1TB lifetime subscription is a one-time $159.99 (reg. $810) for a limited time, giving you ongoing storage access with one upfront purchase.

That 1TB provides room for documents, photos, videos, and other digital files. You can reach them from your smartphone, computer, or through WebDAV, so your storage isn’t tied to a device.

Koofr also connects to existing cloud accounts, including Dropbox, Google Drive, and OneDrive. That’s practical when work documents live in one service and personal files live in another. Centralized access gives you a more convenient starting point without requiring you to remember where every file ended up.

Then there’s the organization side. Koofr Duplicate Finder helps identify unnecessary copies — the digital equivalent of discovering you’ve kept the same receipt three times. Advanced renaming options help bring consistency to file names, while link appearance customization gives you control over how shared links look.

For privacy, Koofr states that it does not track users. Files are encrypted both at rest and during transfer, adding protection while they’re stored and moving between locations.

The interface is designed to be straightforward, whether you’re new to cloud storage or already managing a substantial collection.

For someone who needs ongoing file space and regularly works across devices, that combination makes a clear case for buying once.
